universe.canonical_pair_definition: U = {(min_lex(i,j),max_lex(i,j)) | i,j in O and i != j}

four_phase_planning_coverage.object_selector: A::base_link + F::{LOAD_BRIDGE,M3R_STAGE_A,M3R_STAGE_B} + all S + all R

geometric_oracle_formulae.geometry_state: G_i(q,s,a) is the hash-bound closed collision set for object i at exact binary64 joint vector q, discrete scene state s and asset binding a
geometric_oracle_formulae.unsigned_separation: d_ij(q,s,a) = inf{||x-y||_2 | x in G_i(q,s,a), y in G_j(q,s,a)}
geometric_oracle_formulae.certified_upper_bound: d_upper_ij is a backend-certified upper bound on true separation, or 0 when a complete closed-set intersection/contact witness is certified
geometric_oracle_formulae.safe_rule: SAFE iff every required input/hash/state is bound, all values are finite, backend completeness is certified, and m_lower_ij > 0
geometric_oracle_formulae.unsafe_rule: UNSAFE iff a complete certified upper-bound or intersection/contact witness proves m_upper_ij <= 0; UNSAFE is never inferred from m_lower_ij <= 0 alone
geometric_oracle_formulae.threshold_rule: m_lower_ij <= 0 proves only that SAFE is not certified; without a certified m_upper_ij <= 0 or intersection/contact witness the result is UNKNOWN
geometric_oracle_formulae.exception_rule: Only exact pair_id members of E may return EXEMPT_ADJACENT; exceptions never imply geometric SAFE

row_schema_contract.GEOMETRIC_RESULT: pair_id must be in Q; common plus geometric-query/result fields are mandatory and status is SAFE, UNSAFE, UNKNOWN or FAIL
row_schema_contract.EXCEPTION_RESULT: pair_id must be in E; common plus exception fields are mandatory, status is EXEMPT_ADJACENT, and every geometric/backend/distance/pose/witness field is forbidden rather than zero-filled or null-filled
row_schema_contract.cross_kind_rule: A pair_id in Q cannot emit EXCEPTION_RESULT and a pair_id in E cannot emit GEOMETRIC_RESULT; any mismatch is FAIL_ABORT

numeric_and_shape_contract.clearance_request: authorized_pair_min_mm and required_clearance_mm must be finite, authorized_pair_min_mm >= 0, and required_clearance_mm >= authorized_pair_min_mm; negative, nonfinite or below-policy values are FAIL_ABORT
numeric_and_shape_contract.derates: object_a_hausdorff_derate_mm, object_b_hausdorff_derate_mm and backend_numeric_derate_mm must be finite and >= 0 whenever consumed; a negative or nonfinite derate is FAIL_ABORT
numeric_and_shape_contract.unsigned_backend_value: raw_backend_separation_mm must be finite and >= 0 for every complete geometric result because d_ij is unsigned
numeric_and_shape_contract.lower_bound_arithmetic: certified_separation_lower_bound_mm must be binary64-byte-identical to (((raw_backend_separation_mm - object_a_hausdorff_derate_mm) - object_b_hausdorff_derate_mm) - backend_numeric_derate_mm), evaluated left-to-right with IEEE-754 round-to-nearest ties-to-even and no fused operation
numeric_and_shape_contract.certified_interval: When both bounds are present they must be finite and certified_separation_lower_bound_mm <= certified_separation_upper_bound_mm; an inverted or nonfinite interval is FAIL_ABORT
numeric_and_shape_contract.upper_bound_authority: Every finite certified_separation_upper_bound_mm must be >= 0 and requires a 64-hex certified_upper_bound_evidence_sha256 bound to an independent backend certificate or complete witness; an upper bound is never synthesized from the lower bound or accepted from an unbound caller; a certified intersection/contact uses the canonical unsigned upper bound 0
numeric_and_shape_contract.margin_consistency: Each present certified margin equals its corresponding certified separation bound minus required_clearance_mm under the declared binary64 arithmetic contract
numeric_and_shape_contract.comparison_set: comparison_set_size must be a positive integer for SAFE or UNSAFE; zero, boolean, fractional or negative values are FAIL_ABORT
numeric_and_shape_contract.poses: Each geometry pose is exactly 16 finite binary64 values in row-major 4x4 form and satisfies the separately hash-bound rigid-transform validation policy
numeric_and_shape_contract.witnesses: Each present witness point is exactly 3 finite binary64 millimetre values; missing witnesses are allowed only where the status-specific rule does not require one
numeric_and_shape_contract.status_specific_nullability: SAFE requires a finite positive certified lower margin and complete=true; UNSAFE requires either a finite non-positive certified upper margin or intersection_or_contact_certified=true with unsafe_witness_authority_sha256; UNKNOWN may use null for unresolved numeric fields but can never be promoted to SAFE; geometric numeric fields are forbidden for EXCEPTION_RESULT

status_contract.SAFE: Certified strictly positive lower margin with complete hash/state/geometry/backend binding
status_contract.UNSAFE: Certified upper margin <= 0, including a complete intersection/contact witness; never inferred from a non-positive lower margin alone
status_contract.UNKNOWN: Missing input, missing motion/geometry authority, hash mismatch, empty comparison set, nonfinite value, backend error, incomplete broad/narrow phase, uncertified derating, or threshold ambiguity
status_contract.EXEMPT_ADJACENT: Exact member of E only; excluded from Q and not counted as SAFE
status_contract.FAIL: Malformed request/output, illegal exception, duplicate/missing pair result, or deterministic replay mismatch; execution aborts

batch_completeness_contract.emitted_pair_set: exactly U: all 11175 stable pair_id rows are emitted once under one identical q/scene/asset/allowed-collision binding; no duplicate and no omitted pair_id
batch_completeness_contract.exception_row_set: exactly E: all 9 active adjacent exception pair_id rows are present as EXEMPT_ADJACENT and match the exact allowed_collision_exact_pair_set_sha256; they are never counted as SAFE
batch_completeness_contract.required_pair_set: exactly Q = U minus E: all 11166 query-required pair_id rows return a geometric outcome
batch_completeness_contract.safe_batch: All 11175 stable rows are present, all 9 E rows are valid EXEMPT_ADJACENT, and all 11166 Q rows return SAFE under one identical q/scene/asset/allowed-collision binding
batch_completeness_contract.any_unknown_or_fail: Batch UNKNOWN_ABORT; UNKNOWN can never be converted to SAFE
batch_completeness_contract.pair_result_reuse: Forbidden across any q bytes, scene state, registry, asset, mount, motion, backend or clearance-policy hash change
